difference_from_nearest: PCFDLW changes the admissible candidate set using closure/fidelity certificates; CDTDLEW keeps candidates but changes the decision-loss objective across a channel-tipping ambiguity set.
external_prior_art: Blackwell informativeness under ambiguous experiments and maxmin/Wald comparisons over sets of experiments are established.
mechanism_removing_comparator: ordinary DLEW selection at the nominal channel regime only
new_failure_mode: DLEW can pick the lowest-regret model at one nominal channel even when a nearby channel-informativeness regime reverses that ranking.
non_additive_interaction: CDTS defines the protected ambiguity/regime set and DLEW changes its selection objective to minimax decision regret over that set.
